title: Maths display
description: Fractions, powers, roots and limits shown as real maths.
instructions: Maths is written between dollar signs and drawn with the KaTeX library.

questions.question: What is the value of $\dfrac{3}{2+\sqrt{2}}\times\dfrac{2-\sqrt{2}}{2-\sqrt{2}}$ ?
questions.explanation: The denominator becomes $4-2=2$. Watch out: $(2+\sqrt2)(2-\sqrt2)=4-2$, not $4+2$.

questions.question: For $a>0$: $$\log_b(xy)=\log_b x+\log_b y$$
questions.explanation: This is the product rule. Watch out: it does not hold for $x<0$ and $y<0$.
